title: Arconte da Tempestade
prompt: Create a production pixel-art animation sprite sheet of the EXACT character in the reference. Reference is identity and material design: preserve silhouette, equipment, body parts, colors and proportions. Detailed silver-blue metal, warm golden trim, crisp clustered pixels matching the reference. Fixed camera and facing direction throughout. TRUE distinct whole-body drawings, changed joint angles and silhouettes, no rigid cutout rotation, no duplicated static pose. Every cell contains one complete isolated pose, not pieces. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS and FOUR ROWS, 16 equal square cells, read left-to-right. One animation per row, four sequential frames each. Transparent background alpha 0. No floor, text, numbers, grid lines, frames or scenery. Keep the whole figure INCLUDING effects within middle 65% width and 72% height of each cell, 15% clear gutters. SAME body scale across ALL 16 poses, feet on baseline 85%; a fallen corpse remains low and horizontal, never scaled up to fill the cell. No cropping of weapons or effects. Each row is a separate action; do not mix actions between rows. Four columns within each row correspond to four successive timestamps. Row 1 IDLE: resting, inhale with shoulders lifted, exhale and head turns slightly, rest again; subtle cloth movement. Row 2 WALK cycle in place: left contact, left passing, right contact, right passing, alternating legs and flexing knees; do not translate the entire figure. Row 3 HURT: brace, recoil back with bent knees and head down, recover balance, ready. Row 4 DEATH: stagger, collapse onto knees with weapon lowered, fall horizontally onto side, lifeless collapsed corpse. Last two death frames must be unmistakably horizontal and low, no upright standing death.
